chunks: Then your hearts hardened after that, so they are like stones or even harder; and indeed, among the stones are those from which rivers gush forth; and indeed, among them are those which split open and water flows out; and indeed, among them are those that fall down in fear of Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says hearts became harder than stones?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Qaswah al-Qulub* (hardness of heart), illustrating that spiritual insensitivity is worse than inanimate matter because it lacks the potential for *Khushu'* (humility) seen in stones. The imagery of stones splitting or flowing with water serves as a metaphor for the dormant potential of the human soul to yield to divine command, which the hardened heart fails to do. This highlights the active negligence of the Israelites, who, despite witnessing miracles, allowed their hearts to become calcified against God's will.
